item.title: Guile’s Goofy Popcorn Bucket Makes Movie Night Fun
item.description: Paramount’s Street Fighter bucket, shaped like Guile’s iconic hair, lets fans wear it as a skull‑cap at AMC, cranking hype for the Oct 16 movie debut.
